findings.statement: a thousand keys in the memtable cost the routed scan at least 3x
findings.detail: 78487092 entries/s routed against 32246963 with a thousand unsealed keys (routed vs routed+memtable: greater 2.434x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 4.2%/1.4%)); the fast path over partitions is lost for every entry once any unsealed key lies past the scan's start

findings.statement: four level-0 segments without a memtable scan within 1.5x of the undrained shape
findings.detail: 28295349 entries/s undrained (three segments and the memtable) against 34748044 with four segments and no memtable (undrained vs four-l0: less 0.814x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 5.3%/2.6%)); the level-0 count is the cost

findings.statement: the undrained shape scans at least 5x slower than routed
findings.detail: 78487092 entries/s routed against 28295349 undrained (routed vs undrained: greater 2.774x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 4.2%/5.3%)), EXT.39's 8.6x inside one process

notes: four arms interleaved, the same ordered load each rep, the store left in four shapes: routed (flush); routed plus a thousand keys in the memtable; four level-0 segments and no memtable (seal, no partitioning); undrained (three segments and the memtable). Then ordered scans from random starts; entries per second
